status: PROPOSED — NOT APPROVED. Inert until the owner reviews the licence and fills reviewedBy/reviewedAt/validUntil/robotsCheckedAt/termsCheckedAt. The engine's policy gate (approvedMetadataDiscovery75) rejects it as written.
whyThisSource: Independent regulatory findings (Office for Product Safety and Standards and Trading Standards) about identified products: hazards, non-compliance and corrective measures. Independent of manufacturers; not performance evidence.

licenceFacts.govukStatement: GOV.UK content is published under the OGL v3.0 except where otherwise stated (https://www.gov.uk/help/terms-conditions).
licenceFacts.permits: copy, publish, distribute, transmit, adapt, and exploit commercially and non-commercially, with attribution
licenceFacts.requiredAttribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
exclusionsToRespect: third-party rights: product images and attached PDF reports are not fetched or stored
anything stated as not OGL on the page
toVerifyByOwner: that each notice page carries no 'otherwise stated' exception
that the OGL covers the content API JSON as it covers the HTML page
commercial use for PEE's intended deployment

scope.rate: one request at a time, at least 1 s apart, budgeted per run; stop on 403/429
scope.retained: parsed notice fields (title, dates, notice type, risk level, measures, product type/brand/identifiers, hazard summary and classes, regulations, PSD numbers, notifier) with source URL and attribution; no HTML bodies

evidenceSemantics: A notice attaches to a product only on an exact identifier match (numeric-only codes also need the same brand). Category hazard profiles count notices, not failure rates. Notices never authorise rankings.
